faq.title: Have questions?
faq.q1: How close is the 4K result to the real parts?
faq.a1: Our neural network accounts for light, reflections and shadows, producing a result almost indistinguishable from a real photo.
faq.q2: How does the 3% deposit protect the owner and the workshop?
faq.a2: The deposit reserves the parts in stock and is held safely until the work is done — both sides are guaranteed.
faq.q3: What if the photo is blurry or dark?
faq.a3: The system checks quality automatically and advises you on retaking the photo.
faq.q4: Can studios upload their own inventory?
faq.a4: Yes, on the Pro and Enterprise plans you can sync your own parts and stock.
